biography.value:
Description

A mu looking creature that is usually mistaken as part of the mu family. This creature's bite is not only deadly for its size also inflicts confusion.

Defense

AC 27, touch 18, flat-footed 15 (+8 dex, +1 dodge, +8 natural)

hp 163 (18d10+54)

Fort +14, Ref +19, Will +11

DR 15/-; Immune Blind, Confuse, Death, Doom

Offense

Speed 50 ft., Burrow 30 ft.

Melee Bite +26 (4d6+9/17-20 plus confusion)

Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

Special Attacks Confusion (1d4 rounds, Will DC 22), Critical Attack, Incisor, Macabre, Soul Teeth

Statistics

Str 22, Dex 26, Con 16, Int 4, Wis 16, Cha 6

Base Atk +18; CMB +24; CMD 42

Feats Canny Tumble, Dodge, Improved Initiative, Improved Natural Attack (Bite), Iron Will, Juke, Mobility, Sidestep, Weapons Finesse

Skills Acrobatics +26, Perception +21, Survival +21
